fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2014, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would increase by approximately $2.4 million, excluding the results of our fuel hedge program.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil puts and swaps, and Brent crude oil call options and collars. Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $6.1M at Dec 31 2013. 84.7M gallons covering 36% of projected 2014 fuel requirements settling over next 12 months.

warnings: 84.7M gallons figure from financial notes (settles over next 12 months = 2014); 36% figure from item7a text
